This past January, Veritas Social announced Sloss City Festival, set to take place at the city’s historic Sloss Furnaces on September 18, 2026. The new festival is not to be confused with Sloss Fest, another diverse music festival that was held at the Furnaces before ending its four-year run in 2018. items.title: Spirit Of Talk Talk Celebrates 40 Years Of The Colour Of Spring In London
items.summary: Last night, at the O2 Forum Kentish Town in London, a bunch of musicians gathered to celebrate the late Mark Hollis and the 40th anniversary of The Colour Of Spring , the third studio from British new wave group Talk Talk. The Spirit Of Talk Talk event featured original band members Simon Brenner, Phil Ramocon, and Ian Curnow. With the help of several special guests, they performed most of the classic LP plus tracks from across the band’s catalog.
